settings.label: Our Story
settings.heading: The Beauty of Imperfection
settings.text:
Aela Daily was born from a simple belief: that beauty lies in imperfection. Founded in Berlin in 2026, we work directly with artisans to bring handcrafted wabi-sabi pieces into European homes.

Every table runner is hand-knotted over days. Every basket is coiled with intention. These are not mass-produced items - they are objects with soul.

settings.label: Our Philosophy
settings.quote: In a world of mass production, we choose the path of slow craftsmanship. Each piece carries the mark of the hands that made it - a reminder that the most beautiful things in life cannot be rushed.
settings.author: - Aela Daily
